
[[File:酉の市Torinoichi000.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|de|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|zh|酉の市|lt=Torinoichi}}の{{ill|Rake (tool)|af|Hark|an|Rasclo|ar|مدمة|az|Dırmıq|bar|Reechn|bat_smg|Grieblis|bcl|Kagkag|be|Граблі|be_x_old|Граблі|bg|Гребло (сечиво)|bn|রেক (সরঞ্জাম)|br|Rastell|ca|Rampí|ce|Кагтуха|cs|Hrábě|csb|Grable|cv|Кĕрепле|da|Rive|de|Rechen (Werkzeug)|el|Τσουγκράνα|eo|Rastilo|es|Rastrillo (herramienta)|et|Reha|eu|Eskuare|fa|شن‌کش|fi|Harava|fr|Râteau (outil)|frr|Riiw|fy|Riuwe (harke)|ga|Ráca (uirlis)|gl|Angazo|ha|Manjagara|he|מגרפה|hr|Grablje|hu|Gereblye|hy|Փոցխ|it|Rastrello|ja|熊手|kk|Тырнауыш|ko|갈퀴|ks|پَنٛجہٕ|kv|Нарман|ky|Тырмоо|la|Pecten (instrumentum)|lmo|Restell (arnes)|lt|Grėblys|lv|Grābeklis|mk|Гребло|nl|Hark|nn|Rive|no|Rive|oc|Rastèl|pa|ਕੰਘਾ (ਰੇਕ)|pam|Piruya|pl|Grabie (narzędzie)|pms|Rastel|pt|Ancinho|rsk|Граблї|ru|Грабли|scn|Rastreddu|sd|ڏانداري|sh|Grabulje|simple|Rake|sq|Rashqela|sr|Грабуље|sv|Kratta|szy|Kelup|th|คราด|tly|Dərəǧ|tr|Tırmık|uk|Граблі|ur|جرافہ (اوزار)|vi|Cào (dụng cụ)|vls|Rakel|wa|Rustea|wuu|耙|zea|Rieve|zh|耙|zh_yue|耙|qid=Q200822|lt=Kumade}}]]
'''Washi-no-Miya Shrine''' (鷲宮神社) is the name of a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=shrine}}.

It is a branch of the Ōtori faith based on {{ill|Ōtori taisha|abstract|Q705151|fr|Ōtori-taisha|ja|大鳥大社|my|အိုးတိုရိနတ်ကွန်း နန်းရင်း|zh|大鳥大社|qid=Q705151|lt=Ōtori Taisha}}, though in many cases a Washi-no-Miya Shrine serves as the head shrine of the Kantō region’s {{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|qid=Q11643942}} cult – notably the one enshrined in {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}}’s {{ill|Kuki, Saitama|ar|كوكي (سايتاما)|azb|کوکی، سایتاما|ca|Kuki (Saitama)|ce|Куки (гӀала)|ceb|Kuki-shi|de|Kuki|eo|Kuki|es|Kuki (Saitama)|fa|کوکی، سایتاما|fi|Kuki|fr|Kuki|gl|Kuki|hu|Kuki (település)|id|Kuki, Saitama|it|Kuki (Giappone)|ja|久喜市|ko|구키시|mzn|کوکی، سایتاما|nl|Kuki|no|Kuki|pl|Kuki|pt|Kuki|ro|Kuki|ru|Куки (город)|simple|Kuki, Saitama|sv|Kuki|tg|Куки|th|คูกิ|tl|Kuki, Saitama|tr|Kuki|tt|Куки (шәһәр)|uk|Кукі (Сайтама)|ur|کوکی، سائیتاما|vi|Kuki, Saitama|war|Kuki, Saitama|zh|久喜市|zh_classical|久喜市|zh_min_nan|Kuki-chhī|zh_yue|久喜|qid=Q47535|lt=Kuki City}}. The Washi-no-Miya Shrine in Kuki City was the head shrine (総社) of the {{ill|Ōta clan|en|Ōta clan|qid=Q1391922|lt=Fujiwara no Hidesato's}} {{ill|Q11444411|ja|太田荘|qid=Q11444411}}, and many branch shrines exist mainly along the {{ill|Naka River (Saitama Tokyo)|fa|ناکاگاوا|fr|Naka-gawa (préfecture de Saitama)|ja|中川|ru|Нака (приток Аракавы)|tr|Naka Nehri (Saitama Tokyo)|uk|Річка Нака (Сайтама)|zh|中川 (東京)|qid=Q2613967|lt=Nakagawa}} region. In other areas, however, Washi-no-Miya Shrines are merely branches of other Ōtori faith shrines and may have no connection to the Kuki City shrine.

In addition, along the western part of the {{ill|Arakawa River (Kantō)|arz|نهر اراكاوا|ceb|Ara-kawa (suba sa Hapon, lat 35,76, long 139,76)|de|Arakawa (Bucht von Tokio)|eo|Arakaŭa (rivero)|es|Río Arakawa|eu|Arakawa ibaia|fa|آراکاوا (رود)|fr|Ara-kawa|gn|Ysyry Arakagua|id|Sungai Arakawa (Kantō)|it|Arakawa (fiume)|ja|荒川 (関東)|ko|아라카와강 (간토 지방)|my|အရခဝမြစ် (ခန်းတိုး)|nl|Arakawa (rivier)|no|Arakawa (Kantō)|pt|Rio Arakawa|ru|Аракава (река)|simple|Arakawa River|sv|Arakawa (flod)|th|แม่น้ำอารากาวะ|tr|Arakawa Nehri|uk|Річка Ара (Канто)|vi|Sông Ara|zh|荒川 (關東)|zh_yue|荒川|qid=Q625465|lt=Arakawa}} basin there is the {{ill|Hikawa Shrine|ja|氷川神社 (曖昧さ回避)|th|ศาลเจ้าฮิกาวะ|qid=Q5760456|lt=Hikawa Shrine}}, along the {{ill|Moto-Arakawa River|de|Moto-Arakawa|ja|元荒川|zh|元荒川|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moto-Arakawa|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11388047}} basin there is the {{ill|Hisaizu-jinja|de|Kuizu-Schrein|ja|久伊豆神社 (曖昧さ回避)|zh|久伊豆神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuizu Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 久伊豆神社|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q55523154}}, and in the eastern and northern parts along the {{ill|Tone River|en|Tone River|qid=Q177452|lt=Tone River}} and {{ill|Edo River|en|Edo River|qid=Q1194505|lt=Edogawa River}} basins, many {{ill|Katori Jingū|de|Katori-Schrein|ja|香取神社 (曖昧さ回避)|zh|香取神社|lt=Katori Shrine}} are found. Occasionally, merged shrines such as {{ill|Washi Katori Shrine|de|Washi-Katori-Schrein|ja|鷲香取神社|zh|鷲香取神社}} or {{ill|Katori Washi Shrine|de|Katori-Washi-Schrein|ja|香取鷲神社|zh|香取鷲神社}} appear. Furthermore, since the term “宮” means “shrine,” many places today label their shrines as {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Washi-Schrein|ja|鷲神社|zh|鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11676283}} or {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Nichiwashi-Schrein|ja|日鷲神社|zh|日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nichiwashi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65270357}}, even when their old or common names remain Washi-no-Miya. For example, there is the {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Taito Ward)|de|Washi-Schrein (Taitō)|ja|鷲神社 (台東区)|zh|鷲神社 (台東区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi Shrine (Taitō)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11676284}}, in Taitō Ward, Tokyo (as inscribed on its torii plaque), the {{ill|Washi Shrine (Tsuchiura City, Higashizakicho)|de|Washi-Schrein (Tsuchiura City, Higashizakicho)|ja|鷲神社 (土浦市東崎町)|zh|鷲神社 (土浦市)}}, in Tsuchiura City, Ibaraki, and the {{ill|Hiwashi Shrine|de|Nichiwashi-Schrein (Minamisoma City)|ja|日鷲神社 (南相馬市)|zh|日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nichiwashi Shrine (Minamisoma City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11510871}}, in Minamisoma City, Fukushima.

As a {{ill|religious corporation|de|Religiöse Körperschaft|ja|宗教法人|zh|宗教法人}}, there are nationwide 22 Washi-no-Miya Shrines and 2 Washi-no-Miya Associations.

See also {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|de|Ōtori-Schrein|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|zh|大鳥神社}}, {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Washi-Schrein|ja|鷲神社|zh|鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11676283}}, {{ill|Ōwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Großer Washi-Schrein|ja|大鷲神社|zh|大鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Great Washi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65258950}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Nichiwashi-Schrein|ja|日鷲神社|zh|日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nichiwashi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65270357}}.
